---
name: RFC / design proposal
about: Propose a structural, protocol-level or operator-visible change for discussion before code
title: "📝 RFC: "
labels: proposal
assignees: ""
---

Read the [RFC and proposal process](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/blob/v5/src/docs/rfc-process.md) first. A bug fix, docs change or settled feature does not need an RFC.

## Summary

What are you proposing, and for which release line?

## What we hit

The problem or limitation that prompted this, with links to issues, PRs or code.

## Proposal

The design, in enough detail to argue about.

## Open questions

What you want the maintainers and other contributors to decide.

## Not in scope

What this deliberately does not change.

## Related

Issues, PRs and earlier RFCs.
